title: Indicating and Recording — Flight Warning Computer — Load the Approach Phase Inhibit Configuration File
abstract: A software-only bulletin that extends the phase aware inhibit standard into the approach and landing phases and moves the inhibit table into a separately loadable configuration file.

sections.planning_reason: The first issue removed the take-off acceleration cautions but crew reports continued at a lower rate on approach, particularly during configuration changes with one hydraulic system deliberately depressurised. Eighty-one reports were collected in two years. Operators also asked for the inhibit table to be adjustable without requalifying the whole computer load, which is what a separately loadable configuration file gives them. There is no hardware content in this bulletin.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to load the revised operational software and the new configuration file into both flight warning computers. The configuration file carries the inhibit declaration for the approach and landing phases, derived from air-ground state, computed airspeed, thrust lever position and the slat and flap configuration state. The operational load is updated to accept a separately loaded table. No hardware is changed and the computers are not removed from the rack.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Confirm from the configuration record that the aircraft has embodied TTN-31-1031 and that both computers carry the revised input processing card. Connect the portable data loader at the flight deck loading port. Load the operational software into both computers, and then the configuration file, in that order, using AMM-T-31-50-11-700-001-A. Confirm both part numbers on the maintenance terminal and confirm that the loader has not reported a rejection. Do the flight warning system functional test with the aircraft in the approach configuration on the ground, and confirm that the inhibited parameter set behaves as described in the crew supplement. Do the central warning display check at the position given in the task. Disconnect the loader. Record the modification, update the loadable software list in the aircraft file and issue the crew documentation supplement.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all TITAN-88 aircraft that have embodied TTN-31-1031 or that were delivered post MSN T00155 with the revised input processing card fitted. The loader rejects the configuration file on any other standard, so an aircraft that has not taken the first bulletin must do so first.
sections.material_note: No kit. The software media is issued with this bulletin and may be reproduced by the operator under the terms of the software agreement. No parts and no consumables are required.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled data loading opportunity, or within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
